in_arabic.name: شافیه
in_arabic.long_meaning: شافیه هو اسم عربي يعني المحافظة على الصالحات وتزكية العقل وتطوير الشخصية وتعزیز الإيمان، ويستمد هذا الاسم من الجذر الشاف في الفعل شاف يعني المحافظة، ويُعتبر هذا الاسم من أهم أسماء الإسلام التي تعكس قيم المسلمين، ويتم تعيين هذا الاسم للمرأة التي تتميز بالصبر والثبات على الصالحات وتزكية العقل، ويُعتبر هذا الاسم من أهم أسماء الإسلام التي تعكس قيم المسلمين

in_english.name: Shaafiyah
in_english.meaning: Maintenance of good deeds and purification of the soul
in_english.long_meaning: Shaafiyah is an Islamic name that means maintenance of good deeds and purification of the soul, development of personality, and strengthening of faith, derived from the root shaf, which means maintenance. This name is considered one of the most important Islamic names that reflect the values of Muslims. It is given to a woman who is known for her patience and steadfastness in good deeds, and her efforts to purify her soul. This name is a reflection of the Islamic values of maintaining good deeds and purifying the soul.

data.cultural_impact: The name Shaafiyah is of Arabic origin and is derived from the root word "Shafaa". This word has several meanings in Arabic, one of which is "to help or to be a guide". In the Islamic context, individuals who follow the teachings of Imam Al-Shafi'i, a well-known Muslim scholar and jurist, are referred to as Shaafiyah. Al-Shafi'i founded the Shafii school of Islamic jurisprudence, which is one of the major schools that developed in the early Islamic Period. The name Shaafiyah can be seen as a deep representation of commitment to the religious path through adherence to traditional teachings and guidance from scholars.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Shaafiyah signifies one who is guided, and also one who guides others on the spiritual path. This name carries a deep spiritual significance as it is a reminder of the importance of following the correct religious path, which leads to closeness to Allah. The spiritual significance of this name also resonates with the notion of being a guiding light for others, leading them to the path of knowledge and spiritual growth. In this sense, Shaafiyah embodies the idea of being a blessing and source of guidance to others in their spiritual journey.
